coverage: White Beryl natal printed pp168–177, PDF pp169–178; 14 notes

source_notes.paraphrase: The child's year animal relative to the father's year animal is classified into five auspicious group-to-group pairings with distinct named imagery (e.g. Tiger/Hare father with Horse/Snake child = Great Luminosity).
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: A second five-cell parent-child animal pairing table is deemed inauspicious in both near and remote terms; do not infer measured longevity from its translated symbolic labels.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: An especially unfavorable category is defined by a child whose birth-year animal is in an enemy-relation to the vitality elements of four successive paternal ancestors. Example: mouse/pig child vs four horse/snake paternal generations.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: A natal-year/trigram compatibility table classifies some combinations as difficult for a mother raising the child, including a Tiger/Hare-year child with natal Dva trigram.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: A five-column natal-year-class lookup assigns three successive natal animal-months to ill-health, death and tomb sectors, respectively. For ox/sheep/dog/dragon children it names monkey, bird, and dog months.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: An Earth destiny element with natal Li trigram is used as an example of a favorable prediction involving kindness toward maternal relatives.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: A Tiger-year natal subject with Khon trigram is assigned an unfavorable local-spirit classification, distinct from the favorable Li/Earth example.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: The text compares child's year-sign or trigram to that of mother, father or elder sibling. It gives father-son Khen versus Li and elder-son Khon versus younger Kham as inauspicious example pairs.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: Further charts select whether a proposed risk is for mother, sister, brother or grandfather depending on maternal year/trigram, child's animal-year and sex, rather than implying the child is the sole target.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: Year-sign pairs may be classified as destroying or protecting another's luck: Fire Tiger is cited as detrimental to Iron Dragon, while Earth Tiger is cited as protective for Iron Snake. Direction of effect matters.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: Great, middling, and lesser parental year relationships are distinguished; example mother Snake with child Sheep is called great defect; mother Mouse/Pig with child Ox/Sheep/Dog/Dragon is lesser defect. These are category labels, not observed family outcomes.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: Distinct traditional tables enumerate seven bad-omen years, seven drought years, two sentinel years, twelve years promoting drought, black undertaker years and other symbolic classes. These are taxonomic lists, not independent observed events.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: The supplementary chart lists eight year signs under widowhood and eight under orphanhood, some overlapping other unfavorable-year lists; the age and parent-child situation determine the attributed omen.
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked

source_notes.paraphrase: For alleged disruption of family continuity, the text evaluates father and mother age, outer log-men and inner trigram against the child's sex, with examples for a boy (father age 24, mother 19) and a girl (father 18, mother 15).
source_notes.provenance: translated classical source as presented by Gyurme Dorje 2001, English; original Tibetan not checked
